title: Sour Cream Pilaf Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful pilaf dish made with sour cream and a variety of ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat kissed oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pilaf and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and season with salt.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving bowl and garnish with green onions.
